title: Chase the repair and send the reply
summary: The job drafts an email, stops for approval, sends it once approved, and finishes with a receipt.

steps.text: Reading the thread with the building manager.
Last contact was 28 August. Nothing since.
Drafting a five-line reply with the reference and the date.

payload.subject: HT-4471 heating, still open
payload.body:
Hello,

Reference HT-4471, reported 12 August. The heating in the front room is still off and I have had no update since 28 August.

Could you tell me the date an engineer is booked for?

Thank you.

steps.label: after-denial
steps.title: The send was denied
steps.body: Nothing left the machine. Tell me what to change and I will draft it again.

steps.question: You denied the send. What should the reply say instead?

steps.text: Understood. I will redraft rather than resend.

steps.answer: Stopped at your instruction. Nothing was sent.
